
❯ the library sort is flaky again, can you look

● Found it. The shelf query orders by created_at alone, and two articles imported in the same batch share a timestamp
  to the millisecond, so Postgres returns them in whatever order the plan gives it. That is why the test goes red
  about one run in six and never on a quiet database.

  Two ways to fix it. Add id as a tiebreak in the query itself — ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC — which is what
  pg-shelf.ts already does for the public shelf, so it would be one convention rather than two. Or sort in the client
  after the fetch, which touches nothing server-side but leaves every other caller of the query with the same
  nondeterminism.

  I have the failing test reproduced and red. Tell me which and I'll do it.
